note: Wooded campground of two areas (200s and 300s) where most of the park's electric sites are. Six walk-to tent sites (262-264, 269-271). The equestrian campground is separate, in the Hickory Ridge area. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page, park page, Twin Valley campground map and the DNR notice feed read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). About 144 drive-in sites (200-356) plus 6 walk-to tent sites; the map marks about 97 public sites E (more than the page's park-wide '80 electric'); showers/flush/vault toilets, water and dump; reservations required. Pin at the campground road junction (about 100 m from the OSM polygon centroid). Not waterfront confirmed. Fees and site lengths unconfirmed.
flags: SITES/ELECTRIC CONFLICT: the camping page says 'Electrical hookups are available at 80 sites' park-wide (269 standard sites in both campgrounds), but the Twin Valley map alone marks about 97 public sites E (all of the 300s area and most of the 200s) plus host 200E, and Cox Hollow marks 2 more. The map is probably newer. Neither count nor amperage written (no per-campground count stated; amperage on no page I could read).
